request.description: Opt in to a message when the analysis finishes (`analysis.completed` with `analysisId`) or when a lender moves the file (`application.status` with the application `id` from Apply To Lender). Delivered by push with SMS fallback until a WhatsApp provider is chosen. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.
